name: Flowserve Corporation
content: Flowserve Corporation is a leading manufacturer and aftermarket service provider of comprehensive flow control systems. The company designs and manufactures industrial pumps, seals, and valves, while also providing a range of related flow management services. Flowserve serves a variety of industries, including oil and gas, chemical, power generation, water management, and general industrial markets. With a history spanning over 200 years, the company operates in more than 50 countries, offering highly engineered solutions that help customers move, control, and protect the flow of materials in some of the world's most critical applications.

tabs.label: Management
tabs.content:
Officers

Scott Rowe(Date: 2017 April)

President and Chief Executive Officer

Mr. Rowe has served as President and Chief Executive Officer since April 2017. Prior to joining Flowserve, he served as President of the Cameron Group, a segment of Schlumberger Limited, from April 2016 to April 2017. He previously served as President and CEO of Cameron International Corporation from October 2015 to April 2016.

Amy Schwetz(Date: 2020 February)

Senior Vice President and Chief Financial Officer

Ms. Schwetz has served as Senior Vice President and Chief Financial Officer since February 2020. Prior to joining Flowserve, she served as Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer of Peabody Energy Corporation from July 2015 to February 2020.

Lanesha Minnix(Date: 2023 June)

Senior Vice President, Chief Legal Officer and Corporate Secretary

Ms. Minnix has served as Senior Vice President, Chief Legal Officer and Corporate Secretary since June 2023. Prior to joining Flowserve, she served as Senior Vice President, General Counsel and Corporate Secretary of Ecolab Inc. from March 2022 to June 2023.

Tamara Morytko(Date: 2023 January)

President, Pumps Division

Ms. Morytko has served as President, Pumps Division since January 2023. She previously served as President, Flow Control Division from September 2020 to January 2023. Prior to joining Flowserve, she was Chief Operating Officer of Nidec Motor Corporation.

Directors

Ruby Chandy(Date: 2017 January)

Independent Director

Ms. Chandy was the President of the Industrial Division of Pall Corporation from 2012 to 2015. She previously served as Chief Marketing Officer of Rohm and Haas Company.

Gayla Delly(Date: 2011 January)

Independent Director

Ms. Delly served as President and Chief Executive Officer of Benchmark Electronics Inc. from 2012 to 2016. She is a certified public accountant.

John Friedery(Date: 2007 January)

Independent Director

Mr. Friedery served as Senior Vice President of Ball Corporation and President of Metal Beverage Packaging, Americas and Asia from 2008 to 2010.

Carlyn Taylor(Date: 2023 January)

Independent Director

Ms. Taylor is a Global Co-Leader of Corporate Finance & Restructuring at FTI Consulting, Inc. and has served in various leadership roles there since 2002.

David Roberts(Date: 2011 January)

Non-Executive Chairman

Mr. Roberts served as President and Chief Executive Officer of Carlisle Companies Incorporated from 2007 to 2016 and as Chairman from 2014 to 2017.
